theory.intro: Metric units for mass are milligrams (mg), grams (g), kilograms (kg) and tonnes (t).
facts: To convert to a smaller unit, multiply; to convert to a larger unit, divide.
steps: Identify the given unit and the requested unit.
Multiply by $1000$ for each step from tonnes to kilograms, kilograms to grams, or grams to milligrams. Divide by $1000$ for each step in the opposite direction.
State the converted mass with its unit.

workedExamples.solution_text:
Identify the given unit and the requested unit: milligrams to kilograms.

Convert to a larger unit by dividing by $1000$ for each step: $845\div1000\div1000=0.000845$.

State the converted mass with its unit: $845\text{ mg}=0.000845\text{ kg}$.

Grams are smaller units than kilograms, so multiply by $1000$.

$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}3.18\times1000\\&=3180\end{aligned}$

$3.18\text{ kg}=3180\text{ g}$.

Kilograms are larger units than grams, so divide by $1000$.

$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}9400\div1000\\&=9.4\end{aligned}$

$9400\text{ g}=9.4\text{ kg}$.

foundation.solution_text: Kilograms to grams is one step to a smaller unit. $5.36\times1000=5360$, so the mass is $5360\text{ g}$.
Grams to milligrams is one step to a smaller unit. $34\times1000=34000$, so the mass is $34000\text{ mg}$.
Grams to kilograms is one step to a larger unit. $8200\div1000=8.2$, so the mass is $8.2\text{ kg}$.

development.solution_text: Tonnes to grams is two steps to a smaller unit. $0.0047\times1000\times1000=4700$, so the mass is $4700\text{ g}$.
Grams to tonnes is two steps to a larger unit. $628500\div1000\div1000=0.6285$, so the mass is $0.6285\text{ t}$.
Kilograms to milligrams is two steps to a smaller unit. $0.075\times1000\times1000=75000$, so the mass is $75000\text{ mg}$.

mastery.solution_text: Milligrams to kilograms is two steps to a larger unit. $37.5\div1000\div1000=0.0000375$, so the mass is $0.0000375\text{ kg}$.
Tonnes to grams is two steps to a smaller unit. $0.000086\times1000\times1000=86$, so the mass is $86\text{ g}$.
